title: Illegal Dumping Enforcement / Funding Allocation FY 2026-27 / Stategy of Abatement, Prevention and Enforcement / Citywide Inventory of Chronic Illegal Hotspots / System for Updating / Options for Updating Penalties
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Bureau of Street Services (BSS), in coordination with Los Angeles Sanitation and Environment (LASAN), LAPD, City Atty, and other relevant City departments, be instructed to report to the City Council within 30 days on illegal dumping enforcement activities and the status of funding allocated in the FY 2026-27 budget. This report should include recommendations on needed MN SEP 2 2 2026 resources and funding for strengthening the City's response to illegal dumping toward a comprehensive strategy of abatement, prevention, and enforcement. I FURTHER MOVE that BSS report on the feasibility of utilizing existing City contracts, technology, equipment, and other resources currently available to City departments, including LASAN and LAPD, for the limited purpose of identifying, documenting, investigating, and prosecuting illegal dumping activity. I FURTHER MOVE that BSS, in coordination with each Council District office, be instructed to develop a citywide inventory of chronic illegal dumping hotspots, with each Council District identifying priority locations within its jurisdiction, and report on a system for regularly updating the inventory based on both objective City data and community and Council District input. I FURTHER MOVE that BSS, in coordination with the Los Angeles Police Department and Bureau of Sanitation, be INSTRUCTED to report back in 30 days with options to update penalties for illegal dumping, as well as increasing rewards for successful prosecutions, to align with other municipalities in California. < ) J PRESENTED BY: (/w/l/’i PRESENTED BY:____________ IMELDA PADILLA MARQUEECE HARRIS-DAWSON Councilmember, 6th District Councilmember, 8th District SECONDED BY

requests.asks: Illegal dumping enforcement activities and the status of FY 2026-27 funding, with recommendations on resources and funding for a comprehensive strategy of abatement, prevention and enforcement.
